srList.sentence: Patients were excluded from antifibrinolytic treatment if they had allergy to EACA, disseminated intravascular coagulation, coronary stenting (drug-eluting stent within one year of placement or bare-metal stent within two months of implantation), heart valve replacement, atrial fibrillation, current anticoagulation therapy, or documented personal history of DVT, PE, or hematuria.

srList.sentence: Statistical Analysis A power analysis was conducted in a web calculator using data from Wang et al.2 Results comparing two proportions, IV (81) vs. topical (71), showed that 267 patients per group, or 534 total patients, would have 80 power to detect a significant difference between the two groups using an alpha level of 0.05.

srList.sentence: Continuous data were assessed for normality using the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test.

srList.sentence: Bivariable comparisons by groups were conducted using Pearson Chi-square test, Fisher exact test, Mann-Whitney exact test, ANOVA, Tamhane T2 test (equal variances not assumed), or Kruskal-Wallis exact test.
